# Privexis

Privexis is a privacy evidence workbench for technical discovery and human review of candidate personal-data fields in structured sources.

It supports bounded CSV and read-only SQLite scans, rule-based candidate findings, declared purpose and retention metadata, human review history, synthetic labelled evaluation, and technical exports.

Privexis does not determine lawful basis, certify legal compliance, make deletion decisions, or claim universal data-flow discovery. Findings require human review.

Public pages: /features, /how-it-works, /security, /documentation, /about, /faq, /privacy, /terms, /contact.
